findings.text: non-blocking: `write_plan` imports `reckon._plan_html` locally while the same file imports `shares_one_parse` from that module at module scope (reckon/_store.py:78), so one module is reached by two import mechanisms; it matters only as convention drift.

non-blocking: the counter patches only `_plan_html.BeautifulSoup` and `_StructuredSectionSpanParser.feed`, so a whole-document parse through another parser the repository owns (e.g. reckon/doccheck.py:1692) would go uncounted and the "every parser entry point the write reaches" claim would still pass; I verified the current write path does not reach doccheck's document parsers, so the gate holds today.

item_verdicts.diff: Read commit by commit against 50e7ad1022: fde22f2a adds the parse scope and routes nine readers through it, 8dd03813 is a lint tidy of the new test only; every refusal path and message is unchanged.
item_verdicts.done_when: The done_when names tests/test_a_plan_write_parses_its_document_once.py, and the run records it: node-test.log shows 5 passed at fde22f2a, negative-control.log shows the same file at base 50e7ad1022 failing 2 with "soup parse of a 11935-character document ran 10 times", and timed-write-base.log and timed-write-head.log each name their revision, literal command and closing EXIT=0 for the no-op edit of the monitor plan, whose job 1336679 sacct reports on partition all_debug.
item_verdicts.goal: The node's goal is that one versioned plan write parses the stored document once and the written document once; reckon/_plan_html.py:447 `document_parse` and the re-entrant `one_parse_per_document` scope opened at reckon/_store.py:2070, reckon/mcp_edit_plan.py:2293 and reckon/serve.py `_handle_plan_write` deliver that, and the added test counts exactly one soup and one structural scan of each of the write's two documents.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read; it records status complete, commits fde22f2a and 8dd03813, the 5-passed scoped gate, the base arm's 2 failures, baseline_suite 58 passed and after_suite 63 passed both at EXIT=0, and the two timed-arm logs.
item_verdicts.write_paths: Read the node's declared paths (reckon/_store.py, reckon/_plan_html.py, reckon/serve.py, reckon/mcp_edit_plan.py, the new test, an evidence fragment and a figure); every path in the delivered diff is inside them, and no file outside them was touched.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_plan_write_parses_its_document_once.py:126 instruments `_plan_html.BeautifulSoup` and the structural parser's `feed`, so reinstating a second parse reddens the count at test line 168, which the base arm demonstrates.
justifications.evidence: tests/test_a_plan_write_parses_its_document_once.py:159 asserts the counts against `stored` read by the test itself, and negative-control.log records the same assertion failing at base with "soup parse of a 11935-character document ran 10 times".
justifications.fit: the decorator and scope follow the module's own idiom, naming no plan, sprint or ticket identifier anywhere in reckon/_plan_html.py:435-486 or the new test.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/_plan_html.py:447 `document_parse` returns the one parse of a text held in the write's scope, and the head test asserts exactly one soup and one structural scan of each of the two documents.
justifications.reuse: the repository's nearest owner of a per-pass scope is reckon/resources.py resource_scan_scope (reckon/resources.py:482 `_SCAN_SCOPE`); the addition follows that idiom and no existing parser owner was forked, since file_memo keys by file identity across requests rather than by document text within a write.
justifications.scope_discipline: the five delivered paths are inside the declared set; the declared evidence fragment and figure were left unused and nothing was written outside the set.
